blogs.title: Why Context Windows Hold LLMs Back—and How LongRoPE Breaks the Barrier
blogs.description: An accessible primer on context windows, why most LLMs stall around 128k tokens, and the practical headaches this causes (lost references, fragmented workflows). Introduces LongRoPE’s headline result: pushing context to 2,048,000 tokens while preserving short-context skills.

blogs.title: RoPE, Explained: The Positional Encoding Trick Behind Modern LLMs
blogs.description: A gentle walkthrough of rotary position embeddings (RoPE)—what they are, why they matter, and how simple scaling (linear interpolation, NTK, YaRN) tries to stretch them. Sets the stage for why uniform scaling breaks at extreme lengths.

blogs.title: The Big Insight: Positional Information Isn’t Uniform
blogs.description: Breaks down LongRoPE’s two key discoveries: different RoPE dimensions should be rescaled differently, and early tokens should be preserved with less interpolation. Explains intuitively how this reduces information loss and keeps token distinctions sharp.

blogs.title: Searching for the Sweet Spot: How LongRoPE Uses Evolutionary Algorithms
blogs.description: Demystifies the paper’s search strategy that finds per-dimension rescale factors and a token cutoff. Covers why the search space is huge, how constraints (like monotonic scaling) make it tractable, and how this enables up to 8× extension without any fine-tuning.

blogs.title: From 4k to 2 Million: The Progressive Extension Playbook
blogs.description: Walks readers through the two-stage recipe: search and fine-tune to 256k, then perform a second positional search to leap to 2,048k—without training on million-token sequences. Explains why small, targeted fine-tuning (≈1k steps) is enough.

blogs.title: Keeping Short-Context Skills: How LongRoPE Avoids the ‘Crowding’ Trap
blogs.description: Explains why ultra-long extensions can hurt short-context performance and how LongRoPE ‘recovers’ the 4k–8k range by re-optimizing RoPE for short lengths. Practical guidance on how models dynamically swap factors at inference.

blogs.title: Proof It Works: Perplexity, Passkey Retrieval, and Real Benchmarks
blogs.description: Summarizes results on LLaMA2/Mistral: low perplexity up to 2,048k, ≥90% passkey retrieval across lengths, and competitive accuracy on standard 4k benchmarks. Highlights differences between models and why fine-tuning length choices matter.

blogs.title: What You Can Build Now: LongRoPE’s Impact on Apps and Infrastructure
blogs.description: Translates the research into real-world opportunities—massive document QA, multi-session agents, codebases as context, and long-form synthesis. Notes compatibility (minor positional embedding changes), reuse of existing optimizations, and where data/compute savings come from.
